name: zvideo_d3d_scene_leave
description: zVideoD3D::SceneLeave decrements the Direct3D scene-depth counter and closes the provider scene only for the final leave.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zVideo Direct3D scene/render-state pass because final code shape depends on the scene-depth wrapper pair and provider calls.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4a74f0 validates returning without action when g_zVideo_D3DSceneDepth is nonpositive, decrementing without EndScene for nested depth, calling zVideo_dd3d::EndScene at depth 1, then storing depth - 1 and returning 0.
The native fake-Direct3D smoke verifies nested leave decrements without EndScene, final leave calls EndScene and reaches depth 0, and idle leave remains a no-op.
